title: Alphabet (GOOG) Gained on Strong Cloud Growth and Easing AI Search Concerns
excerpt: Jensen Investment Management, an asset management company based in the US, released its second-quarter 2026 investor letter for the “Jensen Quality Growth Eq...
content_html:
Ricardo Pillai

Mon, July 27, 2026 at 8:06 AM EDT 3 min read

Jensen Investment Management, an asset management company based in the US, released its second-quarter 2026 investor letter for the "Jensen Quality Growth Equity Strategy". A copy of the letter is available to download here. The fund seeks long-term growth by investing in high-quality companies with durable competitive advantages. It returned 10.94% net of fees in Q2 2026, trailing the 15.20% return for the S&P 500 Index. US equities posted their strongest quarter in nearly six years as easing Iran-related tensions, improving financial conditions, resilient consumer spending, and continued AI infrastructure investment lifted markets. AI and memory-related semiconductor stocks led the rally, while lower-quality and momentum stocks outperformed the quality factors central to Jensen's strategy. Quarterly performance benefited from favorable stock selection in Communication Services and no exposure to Energy and Utilities, while selection in Industrials and Information Technology hurt relative returns. The Portfolio remains balanced across quality compounders, AI beneficiaries, and defensive businesses. In addition, please check the Fund's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

In its second-quarter 2026 investor letter, Jensen Quality Growth Equity Strategy highlighted Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOG) as a material performance contributor. Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOG) is a US-based multinational technology company that offers various products and platforms. On July 24, 2026, Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOG) closed at $319.09 per share. One-month return of Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOG) was -4.89% and its shares gained 64.03% over the past 52 weeks. Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOG) has a market capitalization of about $3.89 trillion with a 52-week trading range between $188.70 - $404.47.

Jensen Quality Growth Equity Strategy stated the following regarding Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOG) in its Q2 2026 investor letter:

"Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOG) produced strong quarterly results, reporting strong revenue, earnings, and margin growth. Underpinning these results was strong performance in the company's cloud business, with revenue accelerating over the past several quarters, from 48% year over year (Y/Y) in Q4 to 63% Y/Y in Q1. The company also reported a significant expansion in the backlog from $240 billion as of December 31, 2025, to $462 billion as of March 31, 2026, nearly doubling. Additionally, we believe accelerating revenue growth in the search business over the past four quarters has materially eased investor concerns that generative AI might disintermediate the company's traditional search business."

美国资产管理公司 Jensen Investment Management 发布了“Jensen 优质增长股票策略”2026 年第二季度投资者信函。 该信函的副本可在此处下载。 该基金通过投资具有持久竞争优势的优质公司来寻求长期增长。 2026 年第二季度扣除费用后的回报率为 10.94%，落后于标准普尔 500 指数 15.20% 的回报率。 由于伊朗相关紧张局势的缓解、金融状况的改善、消费者支出的弹性以及持续的人工智能基础设施投资提振了市场，美国股市录得近六年来最强劲的季度表现。 人工智能和内存相关的半导体股票领涨，而质量较低和动量股票的表现优于詹森策略核心的质量因素。 季度业绩受益于通信服务领域的有利股票选择，并且没有投资于能源和公用事业，而工业和信息技术领域的选择则损害了相对回报。 该投资组合在优质复合企业、人工智能受益者和防御性企业之间保持平衡。 此外，请查看该基金的前五名持股，以了解其2026年的最佳选择。

Jensen Quality Growth Equity Strategy 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中强调 Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）是业绩的重要贡献者。 Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）是一家总部位于美国的跨国科技公司，提供各种产品和平台。 2026 年 7 月 24 日，Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）收于每股 319.09 美元。 Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）的一个月回报率为-4.89%，其股价在过去 52 周内上涨了 64.03%。 Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）的市值约为 3.89 万亿美元，52 周交易区间在 188.70 美元至 404.47 美元之间。

Jensen Quality Growth Equity Strategy 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中就 Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）做出了以下陈述：

“Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）公布了强劲的季度业绩，收入、盈利和利润增长强劲。 支撑这些业绩的是公司云业务的强劲表现，过去几个季度收入加速增长，从第四季度的同比增长 (Y/Y) 上升到第一季度的 63%。 该公司还报告称，积压订单从截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的 2,400 亿美元大幅增加至截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的 4,620 亿美元，几乎翻了一番。 此外，我们认为过去四个季度搜索业务收入的加速增长已经大大缓解了投资者对生成式人工智能可能使公司传统搜索业务脱媒的担忧。”
